info.title: Solace API
info.description: The Solace calendar and mail API.

get.summary: The session and user behind the cookie, or null; renews sessions older than a day.
Liveness probe for uptime checks and deploys.
One unauthenticated request to Stalwart's JMAP discovery; 503 when the API cannot reach the mail server.
The session user, or `{ user: null }` without a session.
Confirms request routing and shows the server time.
The session user; 401 without a session.

AuthError.description: Better Auth's error body: a message and a machine-readable code.

AuthSession.description: A session row; the client IP and user agent are never stored, so both are always null.

AuthUser.description: The user as Better Auth returns it: core fields only.

AvatarSizeQuery.description: Query of `GET /api/profiles/avatars/:avatarId`; `size` is rounded up to a stored variant.

blindIndexTokens.description: A JSON array of blind-index tokens, stored as text.

name.description: Empty when the name is encrypted.

calendarName.description: The stored name, so empty for encrypted names.

CalendarSubscription.description: A feed subscription with its mirrored calendar; only the list carries `_count`.

blindIndexTokens.description: A JSON array of blind-index tokens, stored as text.

name.description: Empty when the name is encrypted.

encryptionState.description: Accepted from older clients and ignored; ciphertext presence decides.
Accepted from older clients and ignored; ciphertext presence decides.

oneOf.description: Transient plaintext for invitation mail; never stored.

reminder.description: Minutes before the start, or `null` for none.

title.description: Plaintext content is only accepted without `encryptedContent`.

CreateShareLinkRequest.description: The whole body may be omitted or `null`.

DeleteSubscriptionQuery.description: Query of `DELETE /api/subscriptions/:id`; `true` also deletes the synced events and calendar.

occurrenceDate.description: The occurrence instant; required for `this_only` and `this_and_future`.

recurrence.description: A recurrence rule object as JSON text.

seriesExternalId.description: Set on an override, together with `occurrenceDate`.

blindIndexTokens.description: Parsed from the stored JSON; unreadable values become an empty list.

EncryptionDevice.description: A device's public key and the account keys wrapped to it, stored as the client sent them (trimmed).

ErrorResponse.description: The `lib/errors.ts` envelope; `requestId` is absent on the auth guard's 401/403.

Event.description: A `calendar_event` row with its relations, as create, read, update and list return it.

blindIndexTokens.description: A JSON array of blind-index tokens, stored as text.

id.description: A recurring instance in a list is `<seriesId>_<occurrence ISO instant>`.

isRecurringInstance.description: Set on recurring series rows in a list: `false` for the series row itself, `true` for generated instances.

participants.description: Absent only on whole-series recurring edits that carry no participants.

recurrence.description: A JSON recurrence rule, stored as text.

recurrenceExceptions.description: Present on recurring series rows and their instances in a list.

title.description: Empty for encrypted events: the content lives in `encryptedContent`.

EventCalendar.description: The full `calendar` row an event embeds.

EventCategory.description: The full `event_category` row an event embeds.

events.description: Regular events, recurring series and instances, and detached occurrences, by start.

image.description: A Solace avatar path (`/api/profiles/avatars/:id`, or `/api/profiles/avatar?email=` for remote pictures), never a remote URL.

oneOf.description: The Solace user behind the address, when there is one.

IcsImportResult.description: `POST /api/subscriptions/import-ics`; `fileName` and `calendarName` only answer legacy plaintext imports.

ImportIcsRequest.description: `POST /api/subscriptions/import-ics`: client-encrypted events, or the legacy raw ICS kept for shipped clients.

errors.description: Per-event problems; absent when there were none.

ImportInvitationRequest.description: A decrypted mailed invitation the client imports.

status.description: `accepted` or `tentative`; without it the invitation is staged.

InvitationImportSummary.description: What an ICS invitation import did.

warnings.description: Present only when the invite mail could not be delivered.

MailAccessToken.description: `GET /api/mail/oauth/access-token`: a Stalwart bearer; the wire keeps OAuth's snake_case.

MailAccountId.description: A Stalwart account id, which is also the JMAP `accountId`.

MailBootstrapRequest.description: `POST /api/mail/account/bootstrap`; the mailbox address is the session user's email.

wrappedSecret.description: Optional on the wire, but the service rejects a bootstrap without it.

MailCalendarImportSummary.description: What invitation auto-filing did with the ICS parts it found; also the answer of `POST /api/events/invitations/import-ics`.

oneOf.description: Null when Stalwart's limits could not be read.

MailServerLimits.description: Stalwart's Email and Jmap singleton limits; a field is absent when Stalwart did not report it.

MailSignup.description: The provisioned mailbox returned by bootstrap.

MailSyncCollection.description: One JMAP type's changes; `records` are Stalwart's objects passed through.

MailSyncResult.description: `GET /api/mail/sync`: JMAP deltas since the stored state, plus the invitation import they triggered.

initialized.description: True when this call stored the first JMAP state for the mailbox.

wrappedSecret.description: Null for legacy vaults sealed before the account-key seal existed.

MailVaultBackupRequest.description: `PUT /api/mail/account/vault-backup`; an omitted or null seal keeps the stored one.

MailVaultKdfParams.description: Argon2id parameters of the encrypted private-key vault.

MeResponse.description: `GET /api/me`: the session user, or null without a session.

deletedCount.description: Only on the no-op answer for recurring instances and synced events.

oneOf.description: Absent for recurring instances and synced events, which have no reminders.

OperationWarning.description: A non-fatal problem attached to a successful mutation, such as an invite mail that could not be delivered.

previewDays.description: 7 to 365 days from the start; 90 when omitted.

encryptionKeyVersion.description: Defaults to 1 on the first upload and is kept when omitted later.
Defaults to 1 on the first upload and is kept when omitted later.

RecurrenceRule.description: The JSON object stored (as text) in `calendar_event.recurrence`.

RecurrenceRuleInput.description: A rule object, or the JSON text of one as events store it.

oneOf.description: The parsed rule; absent when it could not be parsed.

categoryId.description: An empty id clears the category.

reminder.description: Any number; stored truncated to whole minutes.

environment.description: `sandbox` or `production`; only the first registration's value is kept.

ResetSnapshot.description: Raw owned calendars, active categories and unsynced events, so a client can re-wrap them on password reset.

RsvpResult.description: A decline answers `{ deleted: true }`; accept and tentative answer the updated event.

SearchEvent.description: A search hit: a subset of the row with trimmed calendar and category.

SolaceProfile.description: A Solace user with a picture: the normalized email and an API-relative avatar path.

StalwartWebhookResult.description: `POST /api/internal/stalwart/webhook`; `enqueuedCount` counts events handed to the push outbox, duplicates included.

SubscribedCalendar.description: The full calendar row behind a subscription, as stored.

blindIndexTokens.description: Raw stored JSON text, not a parsed list.

SubscriptionSyncResult.description: Answer of a manual sync; a failed fetch is an error envelope instead.

SuccessMessage.description: `{ success, message }`, the answer of most deletes and resets.

Timestamp.description: A UTC instant as JavaScript's `toISOString()` writes it: three fractional digits and `Z`.

UnregisterPushDeviceRequest.description: Without a token every device of the user is removed.

displayTitle.description: Sent by shipped binaries; accepted and dropped, never stored.

encryptedDisplayTitle.description: `v1.<iv>.<ciphertext>` under the notification key; omitted keeps the stored one, `null` clears it.

categoryId.description: An empty id clears the category.

recurrence.description: `null` turns a series into a single event.

UploadAvatarRequest.description: A base64 square crop; the API stores only re-encoded WebP variants of it.

workingDays.description: A JSON array of weekday numbers, stored as text.
